description: searchfun.md states 'The role **Data Admin** must be assigned to those who intend to create indexes; and the role **Data Reader** to those who intend to perform searches.' There is no Data Admin role in Couchbase Server's 56-role catalogue. roles.md documents Data Reader (data_reader), Data Writer (data_writer), Data DCP Reader (data_dcp_reader), Data Monitor (data_monitoring) and Data Backup & Restore (data_backup) - plus Bucket Admin (bucket_admin) and Search Admin (fts_admin), either of which may be what was meant for index creation. So a single sentence names one real role and one that does not exist, and the reader cannot tell which is which. The page appears in both the server/ and cloud/ trees with identical wording, so the error is duplicated - same unadapted-shared-content pattern as cloud-sqlpp-pages-cite-server-rbac-roles.
